name: Runner Tests Fixture - Install LoadPackageData
brief: #4061: NavApp.LoadPackageData from an install trigger refuses by name, and a TryFunction does not swallow the not-yet-implemented refusal.
description: AlRunner#4061 / #4049: with BC's install context set, NavApp.LoadPackageData inside an install trigger reaches the package-data import the runner does not implement. The install trigger calls it through a TryFunction; the refusal is not-yet-implemented, which a TryFunction deliberately does not trap, so the bundle must fail naming the API.
